players.name: PhogsToffees

strengths.title: Chance creation
strengths.coach: Made chances for your teammates. Unselfish football is the best kind.

weaknesses.detail: Shots on target: 50% (bottom quarter of forwards is 60% or less)
weaknesses.title: Shot selection
tips: Shoot from central, inside the box. Tight angles and long range are where shots go wide.
Set your feet first if you've got a half second. Off-balance shots fly into the stands.
Tight angle? Cut it back to a teammate. A better shot beats a first shot.
weaknesses.coach: A few too many shots went wide or over. Better looks, better results.

weaknesses.detail: 19/28 passes (68%) - below the ~72% point where extra passes start costing rating
weaknesses.title: Forcing passes
tips: Below about 72% the extra passes start costing us. Pick the simple option until the touch comes back.
Through balls only when the runner is already moving and on the last defender's shoulder.
If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too.
weaknesses.coach: We tried to force a few too many. Not every pass has to be a love letter.

players.headline: Solid forward performance (7.3, above average for the position) - best at chance creation; work on shot selection, forcing passes.

players.name: BellyTb1

strengths.title: Goal threat
strengths.coach: Found the back of the net. Never gets old, does it?

weaknesses.detail: Passes attempted: 15 (bottom quarter of midfielders is 15 or less)
weaknesses.title: On-ball involvement
tips: Show for it. Move into the passing lane and ask for the ball instead of hiding behind your marker.
Give the passer an angle - diagonal to the ball, not flat in a line where it can't reach you.
Move after you pass. A pass-and-move player is always an option.
weaknesses.coach: We didn't see enough of you on the ball. I want you in the thick of it.

weaknesses.detail: Tackles attempted: 1 (bottom quarter of midfielders is 2 or less)
weaknesses.title: Defensive work rate
tips: As a CDM/CM, screen the back line: stay between the ball and our goal and pick off passes.
Get stuck in. A won tackle is worth about 0.2 rating, and even 1 in 8 pays for the attempts.
Track your runner all the way into the box. Most goals against come from late, unmarked runs.
weaknesses.coach: Need more bite without the ball. Defending is everybody's job.

push.title: D 2-2 vs itwasnt6million | You: 7.2 (below average MID)
push.body:
A 7.2, BellyTb1. Think of it like a first pancake. Next one's gonna be golden.

DID WELL
+ A goal against itwasnt6million, your 3rd straight match scoring. Scoring's a lot like karaoke: confidence is half of it.
+ 1 shot on target added +0.1 to your rating. Little things add up.
+ Drew 2-2 with itwasnt6million. A point earned is a point we didn't have.

WORK ON
- Only 15 passes (down from your usual 18). Real talk: Move after you pass. A pass-and-move player is always an option.
- Only 1 tackle attempted. Track your runner all the way into the box. Most goals against come from late, unmarked runs.
- on-ball involvement snagged you and tuxedo_slide both. Buddy system: make triangles, 1-2 touch.
- 0.8 under your average. Every player has those. The great ones answer back.
- Pass accuracy: 73%. You're in the neighborhood. The fancy houses start at 87%+.

Five minutes of this: Talk. Call for it early so the passer knows where you'll be.

Ups and downs make a roller coaster, and roller coasters are fun. - Coach Lasso

players.name: tuxedo_slide

strengths.title: Defensive work rate
strengths.note: Puts in the defensive work and engages the ball carrier.
strengths.coach: You put your foot in and did the dirty work. That doesn't make highlight reels, but it wins matches.

strengths.title: Goal threat
strengths.coach: Found the back of the net. Never gets old, does it?

weaknesses.detail: Pass accuracy: 54% (bottom quarter of midfielders is 71% or less)
weaknesses.title: Passing accuracy
tips: Play in triangles - one or two touches, then move. The ball should do the running, not you.
Scan before the ball gets to you - a quick shoulder check means you already know the pass before you need it.
Open your hips to the field when you receive. Side-on body shape turns a back pass into a forward one.
weaknesses.coach: The passing got a little loose out there.

weaknesses.detail: Passes attempted: 11 (bottom quarter of midfielders is 15 or less)
weaknesses.title: On-ball involvement
tips: Show for it. Move into the passing lane and ask for the ball instead of hiding behind your marker.
Give the passer an angle - diagonal to the ball, not flat in a line where it can't reach you.
Move after you pass. A pass-and-move player is always an option.
weaknesses.coach: We didn't see enough of you on the ball. I want you in the thick of it.

weaknesses.detail: Tackle success: 14% (bottom quarter of midfielders is 18% or less); Won 1 of 7 tackles (14%) - diving in; each miss leaves a runner free
weaknesses.title: Tackle timing
tips: Press to cut the passing lane, not to lunge at the ball carrier from behind.
Delay, deny, then dictate. Jockey goal-side and only commit when their touch gets heavy.
Every missed tackle leaves a runner free behind you. If you're not sure, contain and let cover arrive.
weaknesses.coach: Diving in a bit too eager. Patience in the tackle.

coach.closer: Pick one thing from that list and own it next match. Just one.

push.title: D 2-2 vs itwasnt6million | You: 6.8 (bottom 25% MID)
push.body:
tuxedo_slide, a 6.8 isn't who you are. It's one night. Let's figure out what it's trying to teach us.

DID WELL
+ 7 tackles attempted (up from your usual 2). You got stuck in like a boot in Missouri mud.
+ A goal against itwasnt6million, your 3rd straight match scoring. Goals are like biscuits: always better shared, but I'll take this one.
+ 1 shot on target chipped in +0.1. Pennies make dollars.
+ Split it 2-2 with itwasnt6million. Half a pie is still pie.

WORK ON
- 54% passing (6 of 11). Between you and me: Scan before the ball gets to you - a quick shoulder check means you already know the pass before you need it.
- Only 11 passes (down from your usual 16). Give the passer an angle - diagonal to the ball, not flat in a line where it can't reach you.
- Won 1 of 7 tackles (down from your usual 21%). Try this: Stay on your feet. Slide only when you're certain of the ball and there's somebody behind you.
- You and BellyTb1 were both flagged for on-ball involvement. Fix it as a pair: make triangles, 1-2 touch.
- 0.8 off your norm. Let it go like a bad haircut. It'll grow back.

Training-ground special: Count your touches. Two-touch is a habit that keeps your head up and the ball moving.

Go easy on yourself tonight. Go hard at it tomorrow. - Coach Lasso
